name: GenerateKeystore
description: Generates a Java keystore with a key pair and self-signed certificate.
syntax: GenerateKeystore( string keystore, string keystorePassword, string alias, [string algorithm], [string subject], [struct options] )

params.name: keystore
params.description: Path to keystore file to create

params.name: algorithm
params.description: Key algorithm (RSA-2048, RSA-4096, P-256, P-384, Ed25519, etc.). Default: RSA-2048

params.name: subject
params.description: X.500 distinguished name for the certificate. Default: CN=localhost

params.name: options
params.description: Optional struct with: keystoreType (PKCS12|JKS), keyPassword, validityDays
